question: Can a safe BFM-assisted teacher follow a hand target provably outside fixed-shoulder reach?
delta_rule: fixed-shoulder chain-length sphere intersection at original wrist yz, plus 0.02m in world X
goal_candidate: Original goal_inference of regularized arm+waist IK waypoints in separate MjData; anchored latent differences relative to initial pose, project_z; smooth release; same original arm correction on top. Frozen BFM handles all joints. Privileged oracle, not deployable Student.
waist_candidate: Same original damped bounded Jacobian operator over waist+right arm (10 DOFs), same .04rad perjoint/.08rad total correction; original BFM handles legs. Not claimed WBC.
tracking_success: Hold 3D RMS <1cm and no fall/nonfoot ground contact/actual joint violation; requires crossing rigorous fixed-shoulder lower bound. Improved error alone not success.
early_stop: Original failure thresholds; additional conservative abort at 20deg pelvis tilt, root<0.65m, undesired ground contact, actual joint excess>0.02rad. Failed branches retained, no teacher tuning.
